title: Nonemptiness of the selected Fourier family
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $t$ be a positive rational number, let $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$, and let $J$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates. The family of subsets of $J$ of size at most $\lceil 8t/\varepsilon\rceil$ is nonempty.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\{1,\ldots,n\}$
